title: The Continent - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: The Continent in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The open world that connects every zone. It holds a large share of the game's optional bosses, most of the merchants and the hidden Paint Cages.

sections.title: How to Reach The Continent
sections.content: Unlocked progressively as the story advances. Travel is on foot until Esquie's flight ability opens the water and islands.

sections.title: Bosses Here
sections.content: Bourgeon, Jar, Echassier, Gault, Ramasseur, Reaper Cultist, Chromatic Reaper Cultist, Glaise (Chosen Path)

sections.title: Collectibles & Notable Loot
sections.content: Blodam, Corpeso, Cultam, Painerim, Charnon, Direton, Yeverum
